# Axiom

> Axiom is a local-first desktop application for developers. It gives an AI agent the whole project: chat, files, Git, terminal, and Docker. Code, chat history, and credentials stay on the machine.

Axiom is an agent orchestration system. Four modes cover the work: Agent can read, write, and run sandboxed commands; Plan, Debug, and Ask are narrower, and Ask is read-only. An @ mention pulls in a file, an earlier chat, a rule, a skill, or a multi-step pipeline. Models are interchangeable: major cloud providers, a custom endpoint, local GGUF, or Ollama. The app includes a multi-session terminal, a Git panel (diff, commit, worktrees, sync), and runners for npm, Composer, and Docker Compose. Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers add tools next to the built-in ones.

The current release is a beta, published on GitHub. There is no separate pricing page.
